text:
sam: Thanks everyone for joining today's all-hands. Quick thread to capture the Q&A highlights, a couple clarifications from leadership, and owners for follow-ups.

sam: TL;DR — Dedicated GA moved to a canary next week; Private beta invite list open; demo recording + deck below. Please add any missed items.

jordan: Thanks — quick clarifications: 
- Dedicated GA is gated on the canary metrics (latency & error rate) and the support runbook being complete.
- We're keeping the Dedicated price bands the same as preview but adding a predictable burst option. More details in the pricing doc.

katie: Roadmap note: we're prioritizing latency-sensitive infra improvements over nonblocking UX polish this cycle. That means some Console UX tickets will be deferred by one sprint.

alex: Infra clarification on latency SLO — we confirmed 95th p95 target is 120ms for text-gen on the small model profile, not 75ms (that was an aspirational number). We should be explicit in the release notes.

ben: Eng-SRE will own the canary monitors. I'll put together the alert runbook. Owner: @ben (eng-sre). ETA: 48 hours before canary.

sam: Action items:
- @katie: release checklist + canary playbook (link) — due EOD two days before canary.
- @ben: monitor dashboards + alert runbook — see infra-runbooks/canary-monitoring.md
- @alex: confirm kernel/runtime config for small-model profile and post recommended flags to #eng-runtime.
- @maria: update customer comms template for GA (security + SLA language).

katie: Acked. I'll link the checklist here once I sync with PMs. Draft will be in product/ga-checklist.md

alex: Posted recommended runtime flags in #eng-runtime (small-model: --kv-cache-preload=on --batch-window-ms=6). Will validate in staging.

maria: Drafted customer GA communication template: https://internal.redwood.company/comm-templates/ga-dedicated — feel free to comment.

jordan: Recording & deck: https://drive.redwood.company/all-hands/2026-03-22-recording and https://drive.redwood.company/all-hands/2026-03-22-deck

sam: Two quick asks from the Q&A that we need owners on (not in the slides):
- Post-GA pricing FAQ: owner @sales (recommendation: collaborate with finance)
- Private beta onboarding checklist (on-prem): owner @solutions-eng

ben: I'll coordinate with @ops to sanity-check the infra costs for the pricing FAQ.

maria: Can folks react with :thumbsup: if they can own their listed item or reply if you need to pass it on.

katie: :thumbsup:

ben: :thumbsup: — will also create the canary dashboard in Grafana and share the link.

sam: Thanks — I'll compile these into a short follow-up doc and ping again with final owners and links. If you spot anything missing, add it here.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary run for dedicated-GA on 3302184270 (approx. 18 hours from now). Logs will stream to #eng-releases.

alex: Note: please ensure any PR that touches runtime kernels is labeled 'canary-blocking' so we can freeze merges if needed.

maria: Off-topic but housekeeping — survey link for AH feedback: https://forms.redwood.company/ah-2026-q1 (a couple quick Qs). Please complete by EOD tomorrow.

sam: Closing — expect the follow-up doc in ~4 hours with links and a final owners table. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
